title: Conditional preservation of chimera states under equitable network coarse-graining
summary: Chimera states, characterized by the coexistence of coherent and incoherent dynamics in networks of coupled oscillators, are among the most intriguing collective phenomena in nonlinear systems and are strongly shaped by the underlying topology and initial conditions. Their analysis in large-scale networks remains computationally demanding and motivates the development of coarse-graining strategies that reduce network size while retaining the essential dynamical features of chimera behavior.
